## Purpose
A one-off developer diagnostic. It prints the latest Mistral Workflows executions (up to 8) and the worker deployments for the platform key.

## Responsibilities
- **At import time** it builds a Bearer header from `settings.MISTRAL_API_KEY`.
- **Executions:** `GET https://api.mistral.ai/v1/workflows/executions` (8 s timeout), printing the name, status, start and end time, duration and the first 100 chars of the result.
- **Deployments:** `GET /v1/workflows/deployments`, printing the name, is_active, updated_at and workflow count.

## Key elements
None. It is top-level script code.

## Control flow
It runs at import.

## Data, state and side effects
Read-only HTTP calls to Mistral.

## Configuration
`MISTRAL_API_KEY`, through `app.config`.

## Interactions
It imports `app.config.settings`. Nothing imports it.

## Error handling and edge cases
None. Any HTTP or JSON error crashes the script.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Run it from `backend/`** so `app` is importable.
- **It uses only the platform key,** not workspace keys.
- **It is not part of the app.** The leading underscore marks it as scratch.

## How to rebuild this file
Optional. Write a tiny httpx script with the two GETs and the prints above.

## Tests
None.
